entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 2 . 2 0 1 1 r e n d e r e d b y t h e l e a r n e d

Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No. 8, Ahmedabad recording acquittal for the respondents no. 
1 a n d 2 w h o a r e r e s p e c t i v e l y r e t a i l e r s a n d  manufacturers of the food article branded as "Kapey Glucose" Glucose Biscuit under sections  7(ii) and 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food R/CR.A/338/2012 JUDGMENT Adulteration   A c t 1 9 5 4 ( f o r s h o r t ' t h e P . F . A . A c t ' ) i s a s s a i l e d i n t h i s  a p p e a l u n d e r s e c t i o n 3 7 8 o f t h e C o d e o f C r i m i n a l P r o c e d u r e ( f o r s h o r t  'Cr.P.C') by the complainant. 
2. Having considered the rival contentions, the complaint was lodged on the public  analyst confirming the food article to be misbranded for lack of code number and  manufacturing date on the label of the packaged food branded "Kapey Glucose "/ "Kapey Krazy  Top" Glucose Biscuits.

3 . T r u e i t i s t h a t i n a b s e n c e o f c o d e n u m b e r a n d t h e m a n u f a c t u r i n g  date on the wrapper or label containing food articles, person can be faulted respectively under  r u l e s 3 2 ( e ) a n d 3 2 ( f ) o f t h e P . F . A R u l e s . 
However one of the contentions which found favour with the trial court was non production of  the wrapper/label which was in question, for acquitting the respondents no.1 and 2. 
N o r

w a s  
 
 
t h e  
 
 
p u b l i c  
 
 
a n a l y s t  
e x a m i n e d .
T h u s i n a b s e n c e o f s u c h e v i d e n c e , i t w a s n o t p o s s i b l e f o r t h e
c o u r t t o a s c e r t a i n t h e c o n t e n t s o f l a b e l o r w r a p p e r o f t h e f o o d a r t i c l e .
I n  t h e o p i n i o n o f t h i s c o u r t , f o r t h e a b o v e r e f e r r e d r e a s o n s a n d t h e r e a s o n s
r e c o r d e d b y t h e c o u r t b e l o w , i n t e r f e r e n c e i n t h e o r d e r o f a c q u i t t a l i s n o t
warranted.
Accordingly appeal fails and is dismissed.
4. Record and Proceedings if any shall be returned to the Court below.

(G.R.UDHWANI, J) niru*
